Our services

Heating, plumbing & compliance — done properly

From a single boiler service to full portfolio compliance, every job is carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer with the discipline of a military background and the care of a local business.

Boiler Servicing

An annual service keeps your boiler running safely, efficiently and protects your manufacturer's warranty. We check, clean and certify — and flag small issues before they become expensive ones.

Full service details & pricing

Boiler Repairs

Lost heating or hot water? We diagnose the fault fast, explain the fix in plain English and get you back up and running — with honest pricing and no unnecessary parts.

Common faults & pricing

Boiler Installations

Expert installation of efficient, A-rated boilers sized correctly for your home or rental. Clean, compliant work and a system built to last — with all paperwork handled.

Landlord Gas Safety Certificates (CP12)

Your legal, annual gas safety record — required for every rental with gas appliances and issued only by a Gas Safe registered engineer. We inspect, certify and remind you before next year's is due.

Smoke Alarm Checks

The regulations require a working smoke alarm on every storey, tested at the start of each tenancy. We check, test and document them so you can prove compliance.

Carbon Monoxide Alarm Checks

A CO alarm is required in every room with a combustion appliance. We confirm yours are fitted, working and compliant — protecting your tenants and you.

Heating System Repairs

Cold spots, noisy pipes, pressure problems or a system that just won't behave — we trace the cause and put it right, restoring even, reliable warmth throughout the property.

Radiator Repairs

Cold at the top, leaking at the valve, or never getting warm? We bleed, balance, repair or replace radiators to get every room heating as it should.

Outdoor Taps

A neat, frost-protected outside tap fitted properly — ideal for the garden, car or jet wash. A small job done to a high standard.

Plumbing Repairs

Dripping taps, running toilets, leaks and blockages — fast, tidy plumbing fixes for the everyday problems that can't wait.

Legionella Risk Assessment

A legal duty for landlords — we assess your water systems for Legionella risk, provide a written report and recommend any remedial actions to keep you compliant.

Power Flushing

Sludge and debris make your system slow to heat and expensive to run. A professional power flush clears it out, restores efficiency and extends the life of your boiler.

What we do for homeowners

Heating, gas and plumbing — all under one roof

From your annual boiler service to a full new installation, every job is carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer based right here in Greater Manchester.

Boiler Servicing

An annual service keeps your boiler running safely, efficiently and protects your manufacturer's warranty. We check, clean and certify — flagging small issues before they become expensive ones.

Boiler Repairs

Lost heating or hot water? We diagnose the fault fast, explain the fix in plain English and get you back up and running with honest pricing and no unnecessary parts.

Boiler Installations

New A-rated boiler, sized correctly for your home and installed cleanly. We handle all the paperwork including building regulations notification and manufacturer registration.

Heating System Repairs

Cold spots, noisy pipes, pressure problems or a system that won't behave — we trace the cause and put it right, restoring even warmth throughout your home.

Radiator Repairs

Cold at the top, leaking at the valve or never getting warm? We bleed, balance, repair or replace radiators to get every room heating properly.

Plumbing Repairs

Dripping taps, running toilets, leaks and blockages — fast, tidy plumbing fixes for the everyday problems that can't wait.

Outdoor Taps

A neat, frost-protected outside tap fitted properly — ideal for the garden, car washing or a jet wash. A small job done to a high standard.

Power Flushing

Sludge and debris make your system slow to heat and expensive to run. A power flush clears it out, restores efficiency and extends the life of your boiler.
